question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must implement VXLAN with anycast gateway. To accomplish this, an engineer must set up PIM Source-Specific Multicast for host reachability. Which IP address must be applied to interface loopback1 to accomplish this goal?
context:
Topology: Spine01/Spine02 connect to Leaf101/Leaf102 in POD1. MP-iBGP EVPN Control Plane / VXLAN Data Plane.
SPINE-01#show run pim
ip pim rp-address 10.255.0.100 group-list 225.0.0.0/8
ip pim bsr rp-candidate loopback1 group-list 225.0.0.0/8
ip pim ssm range 232.0.0.0/8
ip pim anycast-rp 10.255.0.100 10.10.0.1
ip pim anycast-rp 10.255.0.100 10.10.0.2

SPINE-01#show run interface loopback1
interface loopback1
  ip router ospf 1 area 0.0.0.0
  ip pim sparse-mode
imageNote: Diagram: Spine01 and Spine02 connect down to Leaf101 and Leaf102 (grouped in POD1, linked to each other) via an MP-iBGP EVPN Control Plane / VXLAN Data Plane.
theory: In VXLAN EVPN fabrics that use PIM Anycast-RP for the multicast underlay (replicating BUM traffic), all rendezvous points share one common anycast RP address configured with ip pim rp-address and advertised as the source in the ip pim anycast-rp statements. That shared anycast address — not either spine's individual anycast-rp peering address used only for RP-to-RP state sync — is what belongs on the loopback interface acting as the RP, which is why loopback1 must carry the anycast RP address (10.255.0.100) rather than one of the per-spine anycast-rp peer addresses. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 1 — PIM Anycast-RP for Source-Specific Multicast)
